title: On Algebras of Functions over Infinite Dimensions
summary: We introduce a family of reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces $\mathcal A_Λ$ of holomorphic functions defined on an infinite--dimensional domain in a separable Hilbert space, $\mathbb{H}$. The reproducing kernel of $\mathcal A_Λ$ is constructed using the covariance operator associated with a Gaussian measure on $\mathbb{H}$, along with a holomorphic function $Λ$ on the unit disk. Under certain conditions on the kernel, $\mathcal A_Λ$ is closed under pointwise multiplication, giving it the structure of a reproducing kernel Hilbert algebra (RKHA).
